issues.description: Captures any issues that occurred while deserializing from filesystem

assetTypeName.description: Specific type name for connected assets. Type referenced must be/extend {@link PhysicalAsset}.

matchConfidenceScoreUpperBounds.description:
An ordered list used to determine inclusive upper bounds for match confidence scores for {DiagramParsingConfig#matchConfidenceLevels}.
For example, by default, a match confidence score of 0.6 implies Medium match confidence and that of 0.9 implies High match confidence.

Note: *order matters* the match confidence score at index 0 corresponds to lowest possible score for match confidence.
[0.5, 0.75, 1]
['Low', 'Medium', 'High']

matchConfidenceLevels.description:
An ordered list used to determine all strings match confidence can qualitatively be set to depending on {DiagramParsingConfig#matchConfidenceScoreUpperBounds}.
For example, the default Medium match confidence corresponds to a match confidence score less than or equal to 0.75 but greater than 0.5.

**IMPORTANT: If you modify this list, you must also modify the match confidence column on DiagramDetailSensorMatchVerificationGrid to match.**

Note: *order matters* the match confidence score at index 0 corresponds to lowest possible match confidence level.

Note: *case sensitive*.

matchConfidenceLevelColors.description:
An ordered list used to map each match confidence level to a color on the UI.
See {DiagramParsingConfig#matchConfidenceLevels} for more information.

Note: If an opaque color is provided, the alpha value will be set to 0.5 on the Diagram Viewer.

Note: Currently will only affect the Diagram Viewer, and the Grid will have to be manually updated to match.
